capabilities: Display a legend of graph color groups, tags and property values with note counts
Highlight or isolate a group's nodes in the graph
Rename a tag across all notes and update its color group
Reorder, recolor and create color groups from tags or properties
Save and apply named sets of color groups
disambiguation: Not just a passive legend; it can rename tags across all notes, edit the graph's color-group settings, and save and apply group sets.
extras: The plugin relies on Obsidian's undocumented graph internals; the highlight feature switches itself off if a future Obsidian version breaks them. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Shows the color groups of the Obsidian graph view as a small legend in the corner of the graph
problem: Obsidian's graph view colors nodes by groups but shows no legend of what each color means and offers no way to manage groups, tags or properties from the graph itself.
summary: Graph view legend that shows color groups, tags and properties, and lets you highlight, rename, recolor, reorder them and save group sets.
